text: Just finished the most recent episode and I feel like one of the missing pieces here may be an idea proposed by Eugenia Cheng in her book <https://www.hachettebookgroup.com/titles/eugenia-cheng/x-y/9781541646506/|x+y> and the <https://www.ted.com/talks/eugenia_cheng_an_unexpected_tool_for_understanding_inequality_abstract_math|TEDx Talk> on the same topic. The idea here is that the terms "Masculine" and "Feminine" are actually already way to overloaded with baggage and instead by re-categorizing values/behaviors as being either "Ingressive or "Congressive" we can shed the baggage of the gender binary inferred by the use of clearly gendered terms.
